purpose: Diagnostic rejection-only semantic prescreen created after Round 1. It can reject a challenger early but cannot promote a model or replace the frozen D-025 benchmark.

pairs.en: The service must keep a local recovery copy until the upload is confirmed.
pairs.id_text: Layanan wajib menyimpan salinan pemulihan lokal sampai unggahan dikonfirmasi.
pairs.requirement: Preserve strong obligation. Do not weaken must/wajib into advice, preference, or optionality.

pairs.en: The service should keep a local recovery copy until the upload is confirmed.
pairs.id_text: Layanan sebaiknya menyimpan salinan pemulihan lokal sampai unggahan dikonfirmasi.
pairs.requirement: Preserve recommendation. Do not strengthen should/sebaiknya into a mandatory requirement.

pairs.en: Operators must not disable checksum verification during import.
pairs.id_text: Operator tidak boleh menonaktifkan verifikasi checksum selama impor.
pairs.requirement: Preserve prohibition. Do not turn must not/tidak boleh into not required, should not, or permission.

pairs.en: Operators do not have to disable checksum verification during import.
pairs.id_text: Operator tidak wajib menonaktifkan verifikasi checksum selama impor.
pairs.requirement: Preserve absence of requirement. Do not turn does not have to/tidak wajib into prohibition.

pairs.en: A guest may view the report, but may not edit it.
pairs.id_text: Tamu boleh melihat laporan, tetapi tidak boleh mengeditnya.
pairs.requirement: Preserve permission to view and prohibition on editing as two distinct permissions.

pairs.en: Exactly one offline copy must remain outside the primary computer.
pairs.id_text: Tepat satu salinan offline wajib tetap berada di luar komputer utama.
pairs.requirement: Preserve exactly-one cardinality, strong obligation, offline status, and outside-primary-computer location.

pairs.en: At least 3 reviewers must approve the release before publication.
pairs.id_text: Setidaknya 3 peninjau wajib menyetujui rilis sebelum publikasi.
pairs.requirement: Preserve minimum cardinality of three, approval obligation, and before-publication ordering.

pairs.en: No more than 24 participants may enter the room.
pairs.id_text: Tidak lebih dari 24 peserta boleh memasuki ruangan.
pairs.requirement: Preserve maximum cardinality of 24 and permission scope.

pairs.en: Unless the client approves the revision by Friday, the original schedule remains active.
pairs.id_text: Kecuali klien menyetujui revisi paling lambat hari Jumat, jadwal asli tetap berlaku.
pairs.requirement: Preserve unless condition, Friday deadline, and original-schedule consequence.

pairs.en: Even if the network reconnects, the failed upload must remain marked as failed.
pairs.id_text: Meskipun jaringan tersambung kembali, unggahan yang gagal wajib tetap ditandai gagal.
pairs.requirement: Preserve concessive even-if condition and mandatory failed status.

pairs.en: Neither the manager nor the assistant approved the request.
pairs.id_text: Baik manajer maupun asisten tidak menyetujui permintaan tersebut.
pairs.requirement: Preserve that both named roles did not approve. Do not change to either/or ambiguity or approval by one party.

pairs.en: Only the second transaction should be shown as paid.
pairs.id_text: Hanya transaksi kedua yang seharusnya ditampilkan sebagai sudah dibayar.
pairs.requirement: Preserve only-scope on the second transaction and recommendation strength.

pairs.en: Rina saved the draft before Dimas reviewed it, and she sent the revision after he replied.
pairs.id_text: Rina menyimpan draf sebelum Dimas meninjaunya, dan ia mengirim revisi setelah Dimas membalas.
pairs.requirement: Preserve actor reference and both before/after event orderings.

pairs.en: When the meeting started, Marcel had already uploaded the corrected file.
pairs.id_text: Saat rapat dimulai, Marcel sudah mengunggah file yang telah diperbaiki.
pairs.requirement: Preserve that upload completed before meeting start.

pairs.en: Version v3.7.2 was approved on 2026-11-04, but deployment is still pending.
pairs.id_text: Versi v3.7.2 disetujui pada 2026-11-04, tetapi penerapannya masih tertunda.
pairs.requirement: Preserve version, ISO date, approval status, contrast, and pending deployment.

pairs.en: The local service listens on 10.24.6.19:8443 and reports status at https://local.example/status.
pairs.id_text: Layanan lokal mendengarkan di 10.24.6.19:8443 dan melaporkan status di https://local.example/status.
pairs.requirement: Preserve IP address, port, URL, local-service role, and status-report relation.
